description.narrative: The Strengthening the resilience of agro-pastoralist communities in the Ferlo zone as part of the Great Green Wall Initiative, implemented by WFP Senegal aims to contribute to strengthen the food security and climate resilience of agro-pastoralist communities in the Linguère and Ranérou-Ferlo Departments by restoring degraded land and improving access to irrigated vegetable and fodder production systems, with a particular focus on women’s economic empowerment and sustainable natural resource management. . The key activities include land restoration, fodder production, creation of vegetable gardens, and irrigation for vegetable production and livestock consumption. The project contributes to the Great Green Wall initiative in Senegal and will be implemented by WFP in partnership with the Senegalese Agency for Reforestation and the Great Green Wall (ASERGMV). This grant is not part of a multi-annual commitment.
